_meta.disclaimer: Elite tier requirements, perks, and redemption ranges are hand-compiled general guidance, not live program terms. Loyalty programs change benefits and pricing frequently and do not offer public APIs for this data — always confirm current details on the program's official site before booking.
_meta.valuationMethod: Point valuations are rough rule-of-thumb estimates (cents per point), used only for an approximate pay-with-points-vs-cash comparison — not a guarantee of achievable value.
_meta.programTypeNote: programType shapes how a chain's card renders: 'redemption-chart' (points needed per night, varies by property tier -- the original US-chain model), 'cashback-currency' (points are pegged 1:1 to the local currency, e.g. India's NeuCoins/Green Points -- no points chart, just an earn-rate and exact balance value), or 'discount-tier' (no points at all, just a member discount percentage by tier, e.g. Oberoi One).
